season.evidence: Snow route from Pioneer Gulch: logged SW Ridge / Pioneer Gulch ascents fall in Apr-Jun (May 14, May 24, Apr 20, Jun). Guide pages (SummitPost Pioneer Gulch/SW Ridge, uoregon peak page, a 2021 April ski report) call spring the preferred window with snow on the upper ridge into June; in summer and fall the Summit Lake south-ridge trail is the usual way. Route text itself pitches it for when snow closes the Summit Lake road.

track.why: Logged route SW Ridge; report starts on NF-2160 near Pioneer Gulch, loses the trail in forest, climbs to a ridge on the left and then the 2600 ft SW ridge to a lower summit then the top, matching our text. Start and end about 30 m apart, summit within 2 m of the Peakbagger point, summited 14 May 2023.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 24 May 2025, summited, line looks like the same SW ridge but starts at a different spur (43.49497,-122.1845) and no route name is logged or described.
20 Apr 2025 ski ascent; starts near the same snowline as 2191040 but no route name logged or described; start/end 1.6 km apart.
July, Summit Lake PCT climbers trail (south ridge).
Rockpile trail / Marie Lake to the south ridge climbers trail, July.
Corrigan Lake Trail / West Ridge, a different line, July.

pins.name: Diamond Peak summit
pins.evidence: Route stores no waypoints. Peakbagger lidar summit coordinate; nine harvested ascents top out within 2-15 m of it.

facts.text: In mid-May the forest between about 6,000 and 7,000 ft is confusing, and a snowshoe track there can melt out.
In mid-May the snow on the final summit ridge swings between firm and postholing; safe but unforgiving off line.
In mid-May snow covered the forest road from about 4,900 ft, so expect extra road miles on snowshoes; the first mile of trail beyond was already bare.
In late April an early start gave snow firm enough to climb in boots, with crampons only for the upper third; skiing down at midday was good.
By late May the snow is consolidated from about 6,000 ft to the top, crampons are optional, and a glissade drops roughly 1,500 ft from the summit.

notes: Pioneer Gulch trailhead coordinate NOT confirmed (USFS page gives directions and 5,600 ft but no lat/lng; SummitPost and Trailforks returned 403; tracks start at 4,900-5,000 ft where snow stopped the car), so no trailhead pin proposed. South Ridge route already has its track. Peakbagger ascents logged 'Rockpile Trail + Marie Lake' are an approach to the south-ridge climbers trail, not a separate route.
